name: Niven
summary: Niven showcases a Maple Brown marble top in a leathered finish, giving the surface a deep, tactile richness with beautifully subdued movement. The vintage brass painted metal frame adds a warm, timeless glow that complements the stone’s natural depth. The overall look is sculptural, refined and quietly opulent. Maple brown marble top(leathering finish), metal frame paint vintage brass. 38×48
